unverified_claims.note: The 74,000 monthly search volume estimate for the keyword cluster around 'AI voice agents', 'voice AI agents', 'AI phone agent', and related terms is a directional estimate. No primary keyword tool (Keywords Everywhere, Ahrefs, SEMrush) was directly queried in this research session. The estimate is based on reported market scale, developer adoption rates (87.5% of builders deploying), and the category's position as a major search trend. Actual volume may be higher when including adjacent terms like 'AI receptionist', 'AI calling agent', and 'voice AI platform'.

unverified_claims.claim: Market share percentages for all five market players
unverified_claims.note: The market share estimates (~35% ElevenLabs, ~25% Vapi, ~20% Retell, ~15% Bland, ~5% Synthflow) are directional estimates based on relative ARR figures, call volumes, and investor commentary. No independent analyst has published a formal market share breakdown for the AI voice agents platform segment. The estimates are marked [unverified est.] in the data file. ElevenLabs' dominance at ~35% is supported by its $500M ARR vs Retell's $60M ARR and Vapi's earlier-stage revenue — but the precise boundaries between vendors are not publicly disclosed.

The AI voice agents category as a dedicated market segment (autonomous, multi-step, LLM-powered voice agents distinct from IVR or traditional chatbots) did not exist in 2021. The first purpose-built platforms (Bland, Retell, Vapi) launched in 2022–2023. Using '+∞' reflects the category creation event rather than a measurable compound growth rate from a 2021 baseline. The broader conversational AI market grew approximately +287% from $5.8B (2021) to $17.97B (2026) per Fortune Business Insights — this is the closest proxy for a 5-year market growth figure.

The +67% figure is specifically for SMB adoption growth year-over-year (not sequential quarter growth) per CX Today / industry research. It is applied as the growth_3m proxy because it represents the fastest-moving adopter cohort and the most recent adoption signal available. No single-quarter sequential growth figure for the overall AI voice agents market was available from a published source in this research.

unverified_claims.claim: AI agents handle 77% of L1-L2 support calls
unverified_claims.note: The 77% L1-L2 containment rate is sourced from CloudTalk's 2026 statistics report. This represents deployments where AI voice agents are in production — not industry-wide averages across all call center deployments (most of which have not yet deployed AI agents). The figure reflects best-practice deployed systems, not an average of all call center traffic globally.
